posts.title: You Seem Pretty Sad for a Boy who's Almost Completed Berkshire
posts.description: I was pretty sad, as I reached the final three pubs of the Berkshire chapter of the Good Beer Guide for 2026. Mainly, because I was always going to be one short, The Swan at East Ilsley being closed since March of this year. Perhaps also because I had to tackle the suburbs of Wokingham.
